provides: npm workspaces api/ and web/ with install, lint, typecheck and test already configured
api/: Express app factory, env validation, error handler and response envelopes, logger, Prisma client and an empty schema with migrations setup
api/src/modules/health with /health/live and /health/ready and its e2e test against PostgreSQL
api/ module layout routes/controllers/services/repositories/schemas with boundary, layer, raw-sql and comment guard scripts
api/ test setup with a guarded test database, per-test truncation and supertest
web/: React + Vite + TypeScript app shell with CSS Modules, an App component and its test, /api proxy for local dev
web/ui-routes.json listing routes for browser evidence

web/index.html with a strict Content-Security-Policy meta (stripped only by the Vite dev server), web/public/_headers and docs/operations/{security-headers.md,Caddyfile.snippet} with the full HTTP security header set
web/public/tokens.css (color roles with automatic dark mode, spacing, fluid type, radii) and web/public/base.css (focus-visible, 24px targets, reduced motion, skip link) linked from index.html
web/public/legal/ provisional Spanish legal pages with [PENDIENTE] markers, linked from the App footer
web/src/components/{Loading,EmptyState,ErrorState}.tsx with accessible roles, CSS Modules and tests

web/scripts/check-static.mjs run by web npm run check:static after the build: CSP, no inline script/style/handlers, no inline style props, legal pages linked, skip link, WCAG AA token contrast, [PENDIENTE] warning
